secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: HMAC key for signing session tokens. Generated for development; set your own for stable sessions across restarts.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional: Google Places API key for restaurant ingestion. App falls back to OpenStreetMap without it.

secrets.name: FOURSQUARE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional: Foursquare API key for restaurant ingestion.

secrets.name: TRIPADVISOR_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional: TripAdvisor API key for restaurant ingestion.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Optional: Google OAuth client ID for social login. Falls back to demo profile without it.

secrets.name: APPLE_SERVICE_ID
secrets.description: Optional: Apple Sign In service ID for social login.
